Lina (CSM): Heads-up team: NovaCorp dedicated go-live is slated for Friday. Need finalize quota table, autoscale rules, and a clear loadtest plan. Renewal touchpoint same week so we must prove stability T+72h.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Got it. What steady and burst targets should I use for generative endpoints?
Priya (SRE): Recommend baseline 180 qps, steady 300 qps, burst up to 700 qps for 5m windows. We'll do three phases: smoke (5m), ramp (20m), soak (45m).
Diego (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare scripts. Planning to run a warmup 24h prior to the ramp to populate KV cache and prefix caches.
Kai (Support): I'll be on-call for Friday and can spin up a dedicated Slack huddle if alerts hit thresholds. Share alert thresholds pls.
Priya (SRE): Alert thresholds: error_rate > 1% for 60s, p95_latency > 600ms for 2m, p99_latency > 1200ms immediate pager. Also enable fallback route to smaller-model pool at p95 > 800ms.
Nora (Product): Product request: expose a per-route circuit breaker flag so we can throttle premium routes during the soak if costs spike. Also want a tiny feedback form embedded in the enablement deck to capture early UX issues.
Lina (CSM): Noted. Ill send the renewal owner a brief status note and attach the enablement deck + short survey. We'll mark this account as "high-touch" for 14 days post-go-live.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Load command I'll use:

```
./stressgen --target https://api.redwood.private/nova --rps 300 --duration 45m --pattern ramp --headers "x-account:nova"
```

Diego (Solutions Eng): For KV priming I'll run the seed tool with the customer prompt corpus T-24h:

```
python tools/kv_seed.py --account nova --file nova_prompts.json --concurrency 8
```

Priya (SRE): Autoscale policy draft:

```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 3
  max_replicas: 14
  scale_by: p95_latency_ms
  target: 420
  evaluation_period_sec: 60
  cool_down_sec: 90
```

Kai (Support): I'll publish a support runbook and a short checklist (where to look: logs, model fallback, token-cost spike). Will also prepare the CSAT + incident survey to send T+48h.
ci-bot: CI pipeline green for nova/onboard - build #4821 at 2024-07-18T10:12:00Z :white_check_mark:
Diego (Solutions Eng): Proposed schedule:
- Thu 02:00 UTC: KV warmup (10m)
- Thu 03:00 UTC: smoke (5m)
- Thu 03:30 UTC: ramp (20m)
- Fri 01:00 UTC: soak (45m) + go-live verification
Lina (CSM): Ops ok with windows. Action items:
1) Priya: commit autoscale policy and add runbook link here.
2) Diego: upload load scripts + raw metrics artifacts to shared drive.
3) Kai: publish support playbook + wire up CSAT.
4) Lina: send renewal note + enablement deck + pre-mortem.
Ping when done. :thumbsup:
